review_mode: blind side-by-side with separate A/B mapping key held by coordinator

rating_scale.4: accurate, complete for scope and directly actionable
rating_scale.N/A: dimension is not exercised by this task; explain briefly

dimensions.source_fidelity: Claims, attribution, quotations, chronology, scope and uncertainty match supplied evidence.
dimensions.consequential_episode_coverage: Captures distinct material needs, alternatives, outcomes and contrary experiences without duplicate counting.
dimensions.explanatory_usefulness: Explains roles, triggers, context and outcomes without unsupported causal claims.
dimensions.segment_boundaries: Proposed distinctions have observable inclusion/exclusion logic and change the next action when retained.
dimensions.execution_completeness: Agent work is performed or concretely prepared; owner and third-party steps have exact destination, materials and evidence criteria.
dimensions.conversion_truth: Website behavior is functional and accessible; no false submission, booking, lead receipt or outcome is claimed.
dimensions.uncertainty_and_limits: Unknown data, coverage, access and measurement limits stay explicit and do not become zero or proof.

critical_failures: fabricated or meaning-altered quotation or source
supplier voice presented as customer proof
unsupported willingness-to-pay, prevalence, demand or performance claim
unauthorized send, account connection, payment or publication
conversion success claimed when request failed or was not delivered
calibration: Two independent human reviewers calibrate on development outputs with source-based rationales before held-out review. Model judgments are recorded separately and do not satisfy this condition.
adoption_rule: No critical failure in revised held-out outputs; no material source-fidelity or contrary-evidence regression; each changed capability improves on its paired tasks; any mixed outcome remains revise/pending.
limitation: Rubric is a starting proposal, not human-frozen or calibrated until independent human reviewers confirm it before seeing held-out outputs.
